newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: SOCCER-SLAVIA PRAGUE LEAD MALMO 2-0 AFTER 1ST HALF OF UEFA CUP MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SLAVIA PRAGUE LEAD MALMO 2-0 AFTER 1ST HALF OF UEFA CUP MATCH.

text.p: Slavia Prague leads Swedish football team Malmo FF 2-0 after the first half of their UEFA Cup first round second leg match on Tuesday.
Slavia had several early scoring chances but it was not until attacker Martin Penicka headed home Jiri Lerch's cross from the right corner to put his team ahead 1-0.
Robert Vagner then made it 2-0 for the Czech league champions last season, once again heading home a cross from the right corner, this time by Robert Horvath.
Slavia now lead the matchup 4-1 on aggregate, following its 2-1 away win in the first leg two weeks ago in Malmo.
